support.html: Contact Email support Send support requests to hello@church-ops.com . Include the account email, team name, and a short description of what you need help with. Email ChurchOps Support

Inside the App Fastest places to start Billing and subscription access: open the Billing screen in Settings. Account deletion: open Settings and use Delete Account. Legal and privacy details: open the links in Settings.

Support Topics What ChurchOps support can help with Sign-in problems or account access issues. Invite, team membership, admin, or owner-transfer questions. Billing, subscription access, seat limits, or restore-purchase questions. Account deletion or last-owner team deletion questions. Google Drive, workflow, or external integration issues. App errors, unexpected behavior, or launch problems on iPhone or Mac.

Helpful Details Include these details when you contact support The email address on the ChurchOps account. The team name. The device and platform you are using. Any error message you saw. The approximate date and time the issue happened.
privacy.html: Overview ChurchOps helps teams run operational workflows. ChurchOps is used by church teams to manage staff access, schedules, board workflows, budgets, requests, reimbursements, time tracking, notifications, and optional external workflows. The app is available on iPhone and Mac. ChurchOps does not sell personal data. Data is used to operate the product and the workflows a team chooses to enable.

Collected Data What information ChurchOps may collect or store Account information such as name, email address, phone number, profile photo, and team membership. Staff and team records such as roles, departments, schedules, approvals, requests, reimbursements, and related workflow data created inside ChurchOps. Subscription and billing state needed to determine whether a team has active access. Device or app data needed to deliver notifications, protect the service, diagnose crashes, and keep the app functioning. Optional integration data when a team connects supported services such as Google Drive or Planning Center-style workflows. User-submitted files and attachments stored through the product, including documents, receipts, and profile images.

Use of Data How ChurchOps uses information To authenticate users and link them to the correct team workspace. To store, synchronize, and display team operational data across supported devices. To deliver push notifications, inbox items, approvals, reminders, and workflow updates. To enforce subscription access and seat usage for the team plan. To troubleshoot product issues, monitor reliability, and improve service quality. To power optional connected workflows such as document syncing or external service handoffs that a team explicitly enables.

Service Providers Third-party services and integrations ChurchOps uses third-party providers to operate the app. Firebase and Google Cloud Used for authentication, database storage, file storage, functions, messaging, app integrity checks, and service reliability tooling. RevenueCat Used to manage subscription and entitlement state for team billing on Apple platforms. Apple platform services Used for in-app purchases, Apple account subscription management, notifications, calendar access when granted, and other operating-system features. Optional team integrations Some teams may connect services such as Google Drive or Planning Center-style data sources. Those integrations are only used when a team chooses to enable them. ChurchOps may share data with these providers only as needed to deliver the features a team uses.

Retention and Deletion How long data may be kept and what deletion means ChurchOps keeps account and team data for as long as it is needed to operate the workspace, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, prevent abuse, or enforce agreements. Users can request account deletion in the app from Settings > Delete Account. When a standard user deletes their account, ChurchOps removes the Firebase Auth account and linked ChurchOps data that belongs to that user, including supported team-linked records tied to the account. If the last active team owner deletes their account, ChurchOps requires an additional confirmation because the workspace itself may also be permanently deleted. Some operational, billing, security, audit, or legal records may be retained for a limited period when reasonably necessary. Apple subscriptions are managed separately from account deletion and remain active until they are canceled through Apple account subscription management. Deleting an account is permanent. If you need help before deleting a paid team account, contact hello@church-ops.com .

Security Security and service protection ChurchOps uses access controls, authenticated backend services, app integrity tooling, and provider security features to help protect the product. No online service can promise absolute security, but ChurchOps takes reasonable steps to protect stored data and access.

Your Choices Your options inside ChurchOps Update account profile information from inside the app. Delete your account from inside the app. Contact support for privacy, billing, or deletion questions. Manage Apple subscriptions through the in-app billing screen or Apple account subscription management.
Contact Contact ChurchOps For privacy questions, support requests, or deletion-related issues, contact hello@church-ops.com .
terms.html: Acceptance Using ChurchOps means you agree to these terms. By creating an account, joining a team, purchasing a plan, or using ChurchOps, you agree to these Terms of Service and the ChurchOps Privacy Policy.

Accounts Accounts and team workspaces Users are responsible for maintaining the security of their login credentials and devices. Admins and team owners are responsible for managing team access, permissions, and connected services. ChurchOps may suspend or restrict access where necessary to protect the service, investigate abuse, or enforce these terms.

Subscriptions Subscriptions, billing, and seat access ChurchOps may require an active team subscription for full operational access. Subscriptions purchased through Apple are billed by Apple under Apple's purchase terms. Canceling or changing a subscription is managed through Apple account subscription management. Account deletion does not automatically cancel an Apple subscription. Team seat limits, access gating, and billing status may be enforced through ChurchOps billing logic and provider entitlement data.

Content User and team content stays the team's responsibility. Teams are responsible for the accuracy, legality, and permissions related to the data, documents, attachments, and workflow records they add to ChurchOps.

Acceptable Use Use ChurchOps lawfully and responsibly. Do not attempt to access data or workspaces you are not authorized to access. Do not use ChurchOps to break the law, harm others, disrupt the service, or abuse integrations. Do not reverse engineer, scrape, or misuse ChurchOps beyond what applicable law permits.

Availability ChurchOps may change over time. ChurchOps may add, remove, or change features, integrations, pricing, and platform support. We may also perform maintenance, fix bugs, and update service behavior to protect the product and improve reliability.

Termination Accounts and teams can be removed. Users can use the in-app Delete Account flow to permanently remove their own account. Deleting the last active team owner may also delete the team workspace after an additional confirmation step. ChurchOps may suspend or terminate access for misuse, nonpayment, risk, or legal compliance reasons.

Disclaimer Service disclaimer and limitation of liability ChurchOps is provided on an as-is and as-available basis. To the fullest extent permitted by law, ChurchOps disclaims warranties not expressly stated here. ChurchOps will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from use of the product.
